insight: ingredients.js PAC/POD derivation ANDs a validity check across 7 sugars including galactose; USDA routinely reports only 5 (no galactose), so the gate almost always fails and PAC/POD are silently left unpopulated. Treat absent galactose/maltose as 0, not as invalid.

The sugar to PAC/POD formula exists twice: ingredients.js:781 takes fractions (0-1), tools.js:174 takes percents (0-100). Same math, 100x apart. Change one and the PAC/POD calculator silently disagrees with the USDA importer.

office-hours Phase 5 writes {user}-{branch}-design-*.md with the raw branch name, so a branch containing / creates a subdirectory. plan-eng-review sanitizes / to - and globs flat, so it reports No design doc found. Write the design doc with the branch slashes already replaced by dashes.

npm test runs node test-app.js, a 1624-line custom Playwright harness with 24 methods and 116 logTest assertions, all via page.evaluate against a live server. testNoConsoleErrors filters type===error only, so console.log spam passes. No pure-function unit lane exists.

CORRECTS usda-pacpod-galactose-gate. The PAC/POD gate fails because of nutrient NAME mismatches, not galactose coverage. FDC returns Glucose (not Glucose (dextrose)) and Total Sugars (not Sugars, Total NLEA). getNutritionValue returns -1 on no match and fails silently, so Sugar never populated either. Measured 0/11 pass with current names, 6/11 with corrected names.

To decide whether an incomplete FDC sugar breakdown is safe to derive from, sum the individual sugars present and compare to Total Sugars. If it reconciles within tolerance the absent sugars are genuinely zero (honey reconciles to 0.03g while reporting no lactose). Beats any hardcoded safely-zero sugar list: self-validating, no chemistry table to maintain.

FDC Foundation records carry Water/Fat/Energy but no individual sugars and no Total Sugars. SR Legacy carries the full sugar profile. ingredients.js:714-735 prefers Foundation, so for formulation it selects the record that cannot produce PAC/POD.
